messages:
anya: running into a bad UX in the async python client when the upstream 500 returns an HTML error page. The client tries `await resp.json()` and raises JSONDecodeError, so we never see the raw HTML body to inspect the stacktrace. minimal repro attached.

anya: trace:```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/worker.py", line 42, in handle
    out = await client.embeddings.create(input)
  File "/venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/redwood_async/client.py", line 310, in create
    return await resp.json()
  File "/venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/aiohttp/client_reqrep.py", line 1128, in json
    return loads(body.decode(encoding))
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
```

anya: headers: `{'content-type': 'text/html; charset=Windows-1252', 'content-length': '2345'}`
anya: body starts like: `b"<html>\r\n<head><title>Server Error</title></head>\r\n<body>\x93Unhandled exception\x94 ..."`

bobby: sounds similar to the non-utf8 handling we saw last month but this is HTML not problem+json. We should not call `.json()` for non-json content-type. At minimum: check content-type, try `.json()` only if it looks like json; otherwise attach raw_body and raw_text and raise an HTTPError with those attributes.

samir: agreed. Two points: (1) content-type can be wrong or missing, so fallback rules needed, (2) we must ensure parity with sync client (sync already exposes raw_body/raw_text on HTTPError).

bobby: proposal: change flow in async client response handling: 1) try resp.json() only if content-type contains 'application/json' or 'problem+json' OR body starts with `{` or `[` after a tolerant decode, 2) if resp.json() fails, read resp.read() into bytes, decode with chardet/cp1252 fallback, attach both bytes and decoded str to the raised exception.

bobby: pseudo:```py
ct = resp.headers.get('content-type','')
if 'json' in ct or raw.peek(1) in (b'{', b'['):
    try:
        payload = await resp.json()
    except Exception:
        raw = await resp.read()
        text = _decode_with_fallback(raw)
        raise HTTPError(status=resp.status, raw_body=raw, raw_text=text)
else:
    raw = await resp.read()
    text = _decode_with_fallback(raw)
    raise HTTPError(status=resp.status, raw_body=raw, raw_text=text, message='non-json response')
```

samir: tests: simulate `text/html; charset=Windows-1252` with non-utf8 bytes and ensure exception.raw_body is bytes and raw_text is str and that no unhandled JSONDecodeError escapes. Also test when content-type is missing but body is JSON-like.

anya: important for oncall: make the HTTPError repr include a short snippet of raw_text (first 200 chars) to avoid completely opaque logs.

devx-release: created PR draft #2891: async: avoid unconditional resp.json(); attach raw_body/raw_text on error; add charset fallback and repr snippet.

ciara-bot: [ticket-bot] Created ticket RN-PLAT-517: async client - preserve raw response (bytes/text) for non-json or non-utf8 error responses.

anya: thumbs up. If we can get a patch release, that would unblock our service. i'll validate with our integration tests once CI runs.

bobby: I'll add a small changelog entry in release notes about exception attribute parity and the new repr snippet.

samir: small follow-up: update docs/devex guide showing how to access exception.raw_body in an async error handler and example code for safety when logging (avoid logging full body by default).
